The work they do to care for patients in our community is second to none.

RT if Americans deserve better.

The BIG Act gives schools the resources to assist students with mental health challenges. Early intervention is key in helping these young people stay on track. 

The Senate must act & pass this essential legislation. https://t.co/RvedeIs5h6

Medicare Advantage provides folks with better services and access to care – with nearly 30 million Americans utilizing the program. 
 
I remain committed to protecting and strengthening Medicare Advantage in Congress. #MedicareAdvantageChampion @protectmyMA https://t.co/tSzkXknpfL

Exciting news for #GA03:

Today, @VFWHQ Post 665 raised the American flag marking opening day of the Robert S. Poydasheff VA clinic in Columbus! 

This new, state-of-the-art facility will provide a wide range of medical services for our veterans. https://t.co/TQksZxJz5O

Earlier this week, I joined a Medicare Advantage Roundtable at Piedmont Fayette Hospital.

We had a robust discussion on the need to improve & preserve the popular Medicare Advantage program to ensure lasting care options for all seniors. https://t.co/fD8TW1wc65

The mental health crisis impacts every community across the country. I’m proud to introduce the Behavioral Health Integration Awareness Act to require the HHS Secretary to reach out to healthcare professionals to inform & raise awareness of behavioral health integration services. https://t.co/hko720y8W9

The vast majority of Americans have returned to life as normal, yet this admin has lagged behind in repealing the COVID public health emergency. 

@HouseGOP today will pass the Pandemic is Over Act, which would immediately end the PHE & Biden’s abuse of these emergency powers.

House Republicans delivered major wins for hardworking Americans this week by passing legislation to:

➡️ Immediately end the COVID public health emergency

➡️ Stop Biden’s big-gov vaccine mandate on health care workers

➡️ Denounce Socialism

Last week, I caught up with Carrollton Mayor Betty Cason & learned more about the Carroll County Crisis Response Team. 

Working alongside law enforcement, the Crisis Response Team responds to calls related to mental health issues & ensures folks get the proper treatment. https://t.co/uzEm8crcHu

Productive visit to Warm Springs Medical Center this week where I learned more about the specific issues facing rural health care providers. 

Thank you to their CEO Karen Daniel and all the folks at the medical center for having me! #GA03 https://t.co/jjcEocA4Xg

Thank you to Dr. Robert Griffin, the Meriwether County school superintendent, for having me at the Manchester High School Report Card Conferences. 

I enjoyed the tour of the wraparound center, which is a new addition to the school & focuses on the student's health & well-being. https://t.co/0uWFoUCS1t

With the growing threat of #AntibioticResistant infections, it’s critically important that Congress acts NOW to #SquashSuperbugs! 

I’m proud to sponsor the #PasteurAct & #SuperBugsAct- which will save lives by ensuring our healthcare system is better prepared. #PassPASTEUR https://t.co/SKWh7t8TYK

It was a pleasure to attend the opening of the Pike VA Clinic this week in Zebulon.

This outpatient facility - which offers primary care & specialty health services - will ensure veterans in our #GA03 community receive timely & accessible care that meets their unique needs. https://t.co/G0VSe06JVF
More information: https://t.co/f7L92AbV2f

Antibiotic resistant infections are becoming more common, & we must act so that the foundation of modern medicine doesn’t crumble. 

The #PASTUERAct would improve appropriate antibiotic use across the healthcare system while promoting new antibiotic development.

(1/2)

Antibiotics make modern medicine possible - but the U.S. is at risk of losing these critical drugs.

The #PASTEURAct brings together the public & private sectors to address drug development market failures and helps usher in a new era of antibiotics.

https://t.co/mcxOiQRil0

Antimicrobial resistance is a public health crisis and if left unaddressed, could one day become our next pandemic.

The #PASTEURAct is a bipartisan, bicameral solution that brings together the public & private sectors to develop novel antibiotics.

More: https://t.co/a8ufDnWG2o

It was great to attend the @HealthInFocus Expo and speak with representatives from Leidos, Johnson & Johnson, City of Hope, and Ontada about their work.

Thank you to Dr. Don Nakayama for the tour of Mercer University School of Medicine’s Columbus campus. They do important training for medical students and conduct impactful medical research at their Columbus campus. https://t.co/hJeTmQzg3D

Today is #NationalRuralHealthDay 

Rural hospitals play an essential role in serving their communities & providing vital care to patients.
